text.title: Record-Replay Debugging Worked Example
text.summary: Canonical happy-path spec emitted from the smoke-test input, then the replay-boundary guard and the mutation-replay harness in code.

example.note: Smoke-test driver values flow through the decision tree to the default leaf (r1-record-all-calls). The emitted JSON satisfies the schema in 02-output-contract.xml.
Bad — empty decision and audit; validator fails fast.

example.title: Replay LLM boundary with strict input-match guard
example.note: Strict input-match guard catches drift the moment a prompt edit changes the path.

example.title: Replay LLM boundary with silent live fallthrough
example.note: Cache miss falls back to a live call; replay is no longer deterministic and silently drifts.

example.title: Mutation-replay: one axis, one assertion
example.note: One mutation, one assertion — clean causal claim.

example.title: Mutation-replay: three axes at once
example.code: fixed = replay_with_mutation( bug_trace, prompt=NEW_PROMPT, model="opus", tool_stub=stub ) assert fixed.success
example.note: Three variables changed at once; you cannot tell which one removed the bug.
